$comment: Package design/g20-spec: every number in docs/G20-DESIGN-SPEC.md that was measured on a photo. Panel px (1920x720, x right, y down), the same frame as design/overlay/. Each entry names the photo it was read on and the method. Photos are rectified to panel px by tools/overlay/rectify.py (08-14, 17, 39; bake/work/overlay/rect/H.json) or, for 34/41/42/43, by tools/g20spec/fit_strip.py. No photo pixels are stored here.
$corrections: 2026-11-16, after the strip packages (docs/strip/*-REPORT.md, design/strip/*/; checked claim by claim by package H, design/strip/H/claims.json). Where a strip package re-measured a number, the entry's 'value' (or field) now holds the new number and 'was' the old one, with 'by' naming the package. (1) Coordinates: the old numbers are in tools/g20spec/zoom.py's pixel-centre convention; the strip packages use continuous panel px (pixel i covers [i, i+1)), about +0.44-0.5 px on a position; entries with 'convention': 'continuous' are the new frame. (2) Every old text height, stem and width is 1-2 px too big: BMW's white text is overexposed in the photos, so half-max edges sit 0.8-1.6 px outside the true ones (package T); positions and advances survive. (3) Photos 60 = 10, 61 = 09, 62 = 08 and 68 = 39 are the same exposures (H): they add resolution, not observations. 34/41/42/43 are our theme over BMW's row and one registration chain (41 via 39, the rest via 41). Disagreements still open are kept as 'open'.

method.glyph_box: tools/g20spec/measure.py --what glyphs: the panel box is warped out of the original photo at 8x panel resolution (Lanczos), blurred by n/6, thresholded at the midpoint between the 5th and 99.5th percentile of the ink channel (max(RGB) for light text, 255-min(RGB) for dark glyphs on the sign, R-max(G,B) for the red ring), then 8-connected components.
method.line_width: half-max of the column-mean profile across the line, 12x supersample
method.circle: least-squares circle through the red-ring ink; r_outer / r_inner are the 99th / 1st percentile of the pixel distance from the fitted centre
method.uncertainty: each rect model has an rms of ~1 panel px over the whole panel, so a single edge is +-1 px; a difference measured inside one crop (cap height, advance, line thickness) is good to about +-0.3 px

runs_text_note: Each run's "text" is an invented stand-in with the photo string's character count, word lengths and height probe; the photo's own text (street names, clock and range readings, messages) is not published. The numbers were measured on the photo's string, so a width deviation from rendering the stand-in is approximate.
